#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#define BUFFER_SIZE 256

int main(void) {
    char input[BUFFER_SIZE];
    printf("Enter a word: ");
    if (fgets(input, sizeof(input), stdin) == NULL) {
        return 1;
    }
    input[strcspn(input, "\n")] = '\0';
    int len = (int)strlen(input);
    printf("You entered '%s' (%d chars)\n", input, len);
    return 0;
}
